agenda_item: Confirm review scope and reporting period
client_question: Which customers, sites, services, and dates are included in this review?
evidence_to_prepare: Approved service scope, covered sites, contract schedule, reporting-period boundaries
metric_definition: Count of in-scope customers, sites, services, and managed endpoints at period end
comparison_period: Current quarter and prior quarter
decision_or_action: Approve the review scope and record exclusions

agenda_item: Close prior-quarter actions
client_question: Which prior actions are complete, overdue, blocked, or no longer required?
evidence_to_prepare: Previous QBR action register with owners, due dates, evidence, and closure decisions
metric_definition: Completed actions divided by actions due during the period; report overdue and blocked items separately
comparison_period: Prior action period through current meeting date
decision_or_action: Close verified actions and reassign or escalate open work

agenda_item: Summarize service availability and material incidents
client_question: What materially affected users or business operations during the period?
evidence_to_prepare: Incident records, outage timeline, affected services, impact assessment, restoration evidence, post-incident actions
metric_definition: Number of material incidents and total user-impact hours using an agreed materiality threshold
comparison_period: Current quarter and trailing four quarters
decision_or_action: Accept incident follow-up actions and risk owners

agenda_item: Review ticket volume and demand mix
client_question: What support demand increased, decreased, or changed category?
evidence_to_prepare: Ticket export with category, priority, customer, site, channel, opened date, closed date, and reopen status
metric_definition: Tickets opened per 100 supported users or endpoints; show categories and priorities separately
comparison_period: Current quarter, prior quarter, and same quarter last year when available
decision_or_action: Choose demand-reduction or training actions for material trends

agenda_item: Review response, restoration, and resolution performance
client_question: Did measured service performance meet the approved SLA definitions?
evidence_to_prepare: Timestamped ticket or incident records, clock-pause reasons, exclusions, breaches, and denominator
metric_definition: Percentage meeting each approved acknowledgement, restoration, and resolution target; do not merge the three clocks
comparison_period: Current quarter and prior quarter
decision_or_action: Approve corrective action for repeated or material breaches

agenda_item: Review customer satisfaction and recurring friction
client_question: What feedback themes should change the service or user experience?
evidence_to_prepare: Survey results, complaint and compliment log, escalation history, qualitative interview notes
metric_definition: Response count, response rate, score distribution, and recurring themes; do not report an average without the response count
comparison_period: Current quarter and trailing four quarters
decision_or_action: Prioritize one to three experience improvements

agenda_item: Reconcile managed endpoint coverage
client_question: Does the managed inventory match the authorized estate?
evidence_to_prepare: RMM inventory export, customer asset register, joiner/mover/leaver records, stale-device list, excluded-device register
metric_definition: In-scope endpoints reporting within the approved freshness window divided by authorized in-scope endpoints
comparison_period: Current period end and prior period end
decision_or_action: Resolve missing, duplicate, stale, or unauthorized endpoint records

agenda_item: Review unsupported and aging systems
client_question: Which endpoints, operating systems, or applications are approaching or beyond support?
evidence_to_prepare: Hardware age, warranty status, operating-system version, application inventory, vendor lifecycle sources
metric_definition: Count and percentage of in-scope endpoints in approved lifecycle-risk bands
comparison_period: Current period end and next 12 months
decision_or_action: Approve replacement, upgrade, exception, or risk-acceptance actions

agenda_item: Review alert volume and signal quality
client_question: Which alerts led to useful action, noise, duplicates, or missed conditions?
evidence_to_prepare: Alert history, deduplication rules, suppressed events, false-positive review, incident linkage
metric_definition: Actionable unique incidents divided by total alert events; report duplicate and false-positive counts separately
comparison_period: Current quarter and prior quarter
decision_or_action: Approve alert tuning with a bounded validation plan

agenda_item: Review unresolved and recurring conditions
client_question: Which device or service conditions remain open or repeatedly return?
evidence_to_prepare: Open alert list, recurrence history, linked tickets, root-cause notes, exception approvals
metric_definition: Open conditions by age band and recurring conditions by rule and endpoint
comparison_period: Current period end and prior period end
decision_or_action: Assign remediation, exception, or retirement decisions

agenda_item: Report patch compliance with the denominator
client_question: What completed, failed, requires restart, is exempt, or has stopped reporting?
evidence_to_prepare: Applicable-update inventory, installation results, restart state, failure details, approved exceptions, stale-device list
metric_definition: Verified installed endpoints divided by all applicable in-scope endpoints; show failed, pending restart, excepted, and unknown states separately
comparison_period: Current reporting window and prior reporting window
decision_or_action: Approve remediation and exception-expiry actions

agenda_item: Review patch failures and exception aging
client_question: Which failures or deferrals create material exposure or repeated effort?
evidence_to_prepare: Failure codes, retry history, maintenance-window evidence, exception owner, expiry date, compensating control
metric_definition: Open failures and exceptions by age, severity, endpoint group, and owner
comparison_period: Current period end and prior period end
decision_or_action: Escalate expired exceptions and repeated failure patterns

agenda_item: Review privileged access and technician changes
client_question: Did privileged access remain authorized, least-privileged, and attributable?
evidence_to_prepare: Technician roster, role assignments, MFA status, access-review evidence, joiner/mover/leaver records, audit events
metric_definition: Privileged accounts reviewed and approved divided by privileged accounts in scope; list exceptions separately
comparison_period: Current quarter
decision_or_action: Revoke, reduce, approve, or investigate access

agenda_item: Review remote-support activity
client_question: Were remote sessions authorized, attributable, scoped, and closed correctly?
evidence_to_prepare: Remote-session history, technician identity, endpoint identity, approval or notice, timestamps, session evidence
metric_definition: Sessions with complete required evidence divided by all in-scope sessions; show unattended and emergency sessions separately
comparison_period: Current quarter and prior quarter
decision_or_action: Correct evidence gaps or authorization controls

agenda_item: Review security events and control gaps
client_question: Which events, findings, or control failures need executive risk decisions?
evidence_to_prepare: Security incident records, vulnerability findings, control-test results, risk register, remediation evidence
metric_definition: Open material findings by severity and age; report accepted risk separately from unresolved work
comparison_period: Current period end and prior period end
decision_or_action: Accept, remediate, transfer, or escalate each material risk

agenda_item: Review automation outcomes and failures
client_question: Which automated jobs saved work, failed, timed out, or produced unexpected results?
evidence_to_prepare: Job history, target scope, success criteria, output evidence, failure and timeout records, rollback notes
metric_definition: Successful verified runs divided by completed runs; show failures, timeouts, skipped targets, and unverified outcomes separately
comparison_period: Current quarter and prior quarter
decision_or_action: Retire, repair, expand, or constrain automations

agenda_item: Review completed and upcoming changes
client_question: What changed, what evidence proves success, and what is scheduled next?
evidence_to_prepare: Change records, approvals, rollout and rollback evidence, validation results, forward change calendar
metric_definition: Completed changes by outcome; upcoming changes by risk and business impact
comparison_period: Current quarter and next quarter
decision_or_action: Approve upcoming windows, owners, and communications

agenda_item: Review project portfolio and dependency risks
client_question: Which projects are on track, blocked, over budget, or waiting on customer decisions?
evidence_to_prepare: Project plan, milestones, budget, dependency log, issue log, decision register
metric_definition: Milestones completed on time divided by milestones due; report blocked milestones and dependency age separately
comparison_period: Current quarter and next two quarters
decision_or_action: Resolve dependencies and approve scope, budget, or schedule changes

agenda_item: Review backup and restore evidence
client_question: Can the agreed systems and data be restored within approved objectives?
evidence_to_prepare: Backup-job history, protected-scope inventory, restore-test evidence, recovery objectives, failure and exception log
metric_definition: Successful verified restore tests divided by restore tests due; show untested, failed, and out-of-scope systems separately
comparison_period: Current quarter and trailing 12 months
decision_or_action: Approve remediation and the next restore-test scope

agenda_item: Review business continuity and escalation contacts
client_question: Are recovery priorities, contacts, suppliers, and escalation paths current?
evidence_to_prepare: Business continuity plan, contact roster, supplier dependencies, invocation criteria, exercise results
metric_definition: Reviewed critical services and contacts divided by items in the approved continuity scope
comparison_period: Current quarter
decision_or_action: Update ownership, priorities, contact paths, or exercise schedule

agenda_item: Reconcile service scope, usage, and retained tools
client_question: Does the current agreement match actual users, endpoints, locations, services, and dependencies?
evidence_to_prepare: Contract schedule, current inventory, license and subscription list, usage records, excluded-service list
metric_definition: Actual in-scope units compared with contracted units; show retained third-party tools and uncovered dependencies separately
comparison_period: Current period end and contract baseline
decision_or_action: Approve scope correction, renewal change, or documented exception

agenda_item: Review roadmap, lifecycle, and budget decisions
client_question: Which technology decisions need funding or executive sponsorship in the next 12 months?
evidence_to_prepare: Lifecycle forecast, project estimates, risk register, vendor notices, dependency map, budget assumptions
metric_definition: Forecast spend by initiative and quarter; separate committed, proposed, and contingency amounts
comparison_period: Next four quarters
decision_or_action: Prioritize initiatives and assign budget decision dates

agenda_item: Record decisions, risks, and accepted exceptions
client_question: Which decisions were made, deferred, rejected, or accepted as risk?
evidence_to_prepare: Meeting decision log, risk register, exception register, approval evidence
metric_definition: Count of decisions by status and open risks or exceptions by owner and due date
comparison_period: Meeting date and open-item history
decision_or_action: Approve the decision and risk register

agenda_item: Publish the next-quarter action plan
client_question: Who owns each agreed action, what outcome proves completion, and when is it due?
evidence_to_prepare: Draft action register with owner, due date, dependency, success evidence, and escalation path
metric_definition: Actions with named owners and due dates divided by all agreed actions
comparison_period: Next quarter
decision_or_action: Approve and distribute the final action register and next review date
